question.explanationHtml: A warranty is a promise the manufacturer makes to the consumer.

question.transcriptHtml: A warranty is a promise the manufacturer makes to the consumer.

question.explanationHtml: Consumer laws are designed to protect the public against unscrupulous vendors.

question.transcriptHtml: Consumer laws are designed to protect the public against unscrupulous vendors.

question.explanationHtml: Even though the salesperson showed me a product i had never heard of, I bought it because of the good reputation of the manufacturer.
